recommendation: Keep the audit as-is. Future changes to detailed pre-adoption mechanics should be made in the cross-version package/source workflow, while core versions.html should continue to provide the stable overview and package links.
issue_request: FHIR-31999 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core clarification request asking whether the cross-version extension URL mechanism can be used to pre-adopt content such as R5 SupplyRequest.item from an earlier version, and whether that applies to new backbone elements, cardinality increases, and expanded reference targets.
initial_application: No source commit was found that explicitly mentions FHIR-31999. The same compatibility section was updated by FHIR-31348, FHIR-36702, and FHIR-31721; FHIR-31721 added R5-era detailed guidance for complex extensions, cardinality increases, targetProfile differences, alternate-reference/alternate-canonical, and complex-extension examples.
additional_context: The current core page was later refactored by f45505e5b3a to move detailed cross-version conversion content out of versions.html and into individual cross-version definition packages. Current references.html and the Extension Pack define alternate-reference for cases where a resource target is not allowed by the base element. The published R5-to-R4 cross-version package demonstrates the SupplyRequest.item case directly with a complex extension and DeviceDefinition in the CodeableReference reference slice.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was made because the current core page remains the build-scope overview and delegates detailed mechanics to package-owned cross-version definitions.
